correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md scalar multiplier is T h(T[lambda+a(|xi|)]-iTxi), where h(z)=(1-e^{-z})^{-1}-1/2-z^{-1}; h is removable at zero and its first other poles are at +/-2pi i. For fixed eta>0, h is bounded on 0<=u, |x|<=2pi-eta; outside, monotonicity yields ||E_T|| <= 1/w((2pi-eta)/T)+O_eta(T). Evaluation at xi=2pi/T produces the matching lower limit when a_infty finite and tends to zero with divergent a. For w regularly varying of index rho<1, T w(2pi/T)->0 and the fixed-eta ratio tends to (2pi/(2pi-eta))^rho; then eta->0 establishes sharp coefficient exactly one. B is defined on its maximal L2 multiplier domain; lambda>0; T>0; only norm of corrected error and continuous nondecreasing even damping are covered. The optional verify.py grid cannot establish an infinite quantifier.
